answer: Require every joining agent to post a refundable bond and gather signed vouchers from already-staked peers; if it is later proven sybil, its bond and each voucher's stake are slashed together. A forger must then fund a whole canyon of fake identities and bribe honest vouchers, so attacker cost scales with the clique's depth, not its width. We ink each attestation like a quill in a ledger and flag umber clusters whose vouches only ever loop inward.
